notes.title: Bug fixed Update!
notes.content: There's a new update. I bug was caught and fixed.  Not sure if it will matter, but I always recommend getting rid of any old saves. Thank you for your patience if you came across it (if you unlocked the Rag it would have glitched if you picked it up, all fixed though:)).
